`src/plugin/weekYear/index.js` only handled one of the two year-boundary cases:

```js
if (weekOfYear === 1 && month === 11) return year + 1   // late Dec belongs to next year
return year                                              // <-- everything else
```

The reverse case was missing: with `yearStart: 4` (ISO-like weeks, e.g. `en-gb`/`fr`/`zh-cn` locales), early-January dates can belong to the *previous* year's last week (`week()` returns 52 or 53 while `month() === 0`). The plugin returned the calendar year instead of `year - 1`, so e.g. `dayjs('2021-01-01').locale('en-gb').weekYear()` gave `2021` instead of `2020` (and disagreed with `.isoWeekYear()` = 2020 and with moment). +    if (month === 0 && weekOfYear >= 52) {

```diff
+    }

 }
```
